## Material Description

This tutorial expands on the previous dataset merging tutorial by using a fuzzy matching pipeline to resolve records that could not be matched through exact ID or address matching. It covers the basics of fuzzy matching, considerations when setting up a repeatable matching protocol, and manual review of the implementation.
